BackfillStrategy.description_en: The backfill evaluation policy for historical data, which specifies the time range and trigger method for a backfill run
BackfillStrategy.description_zh: 历史数据回填评估策略，用于指定一次回填运行的时间范围和触发方式

enabled.description_en: Specifies whether the backfill policy is enabled. If this parameter is not specified or is set to true, the policy is enabled. If this parameter is set to false, the policy is disabled but the configuration is retained
enabled.description_zh: 是否启用回填策略。不传或 true 表示启用；false 表示关闭但保留配置

endTime.description_en: The end of the backfill time range, in UNIX millisecond timestamp. Provide a complete time range when you need to manually start a backfill
endTime.description_zh: 回填时间范围终点，Unix 毫秒时间戳。需要手动启动回填时应提供完整时间范围

startTime.description_en: The start of the backfill time range, in UNIX millisecond timestamp. Provide a complete time range when you need to manually start a backfill
startTime.description_zh: 回填时间范围起点，Unix 毫秒时间戳。需要手动启动回填时应提供完整时间范围

ContinuousStrategy.description_en: The continuous evaluation policy, which is used to continuously evaluate new data within fixed time windows
ContinuousStrategy.description_zh: 持续评估策略，用于按固定时间窗口持续评估新增数据

dataDelayMinutes.description_en: The data arrival delay in minutes. After a window ends, the system waits for this duration before creating a run to allow data to arrive completely. Default value: 0
dataDelayMinutes.description_zh: 数据到达延迟时间，单位为分钟。窗口结束后延迟该时间再创建运行，用于等待数据完整到达；不传默认为 0

enabled.description_en: Specifies whether to enable continuous evaluation. If this parameter is not specified or is set to true, continuous evaluation is enabled. If this parameter is set to false, continuous evaluation is disabled but the configuration is retained
enabled.description_zh: 是否启用持续评估。不传或 true 表示启用；false 表示关闭但保留配置

intervalUnit.description_en: The unit of the continuous evaluation window interval. This field is required for the current polling implementation
intervalUnit.description_zh: 持续评估窗口间隔单位。当前轮询实现需要该字段

intervalValue.description_en: The size of the continuous evaluation window interval. This parameter is used together with intervalUnit. The value must be greater than 0
intervalValue.description_zh: 持续评估窗口间隔大小，需要与 intervalUnit 配合使用，取值应大于 0

Evaluator.description_en: The evaluator configuration in an evaluation task. Used to reference a previously created evaluator or to describe an inline evaluator for the task
Evaluator.description_zh: 评估任务中的评估器配置，用于引用已创建的评估器，或以内联方式描述本次任务使用的评估器

config.description_en: The evaluator runtime configuration. For inline LLM evaluators, this must include configurations such as prompt. When referencing an existing evaluator, this parameter is typically not required and is only specified when runtime parameters such as version need to be set
config.description_zh: 评估器运行配置。内联 LLM 评估器需要包含 prompt 等配置；引用已有评估器时通常不传，仅在需要指定版本等运行时参数时传入
config.title: 评估器配置（如prompt等）

evaluatorRef.description_en: The reference name of a registered evaluator. When specified, the evaluator definition is loaded by this reference with higher priority. Both built-in evaluators and custom evaluators are supported
evaluatorRef.description_zh: 已注册评估器的引用名称。传入后优先按该引用加载评估器定义，支持内置评估器和自定义评估器
evaluatorRef.title: 评估器引用ID（引用已注册评估器时使用）

filters.description_en: The evaluator-level data filter conditions. These take effect together with the task-level dataFilter.query
filters.description_zh: 评估器级数据筛选条件，会与任务级 dataFilter.query 共同生效
filters.title: 数据筛选条件

name.description_en: The evaluator name. Required for inline evaluators when evaluatorRef is not specified. The evaluatorRef or name must be unique within the same task
name.description_zh: 评估器名称。未传 evaluatorRef 的内联评估器场景必填；同一任务内 evaluatorRef 或 name 不能重复
name.title: 评估器名称

resultName.description_en: The field name for the evaluation result. Required for inline evaluators. When referencing an existing evaluator, the metricName defined in the evaluator definition is used if this parameter is not specified
resultName.description_zh: 评估结果字段名。内联评估器场景必填；引用已有评估器时未传则使用评估器定义中的 metricName
resultName.title: 评分名称

resultType.description_en: The evaluation result type. Required for inline evaluators. Defaults to score when referencing an existing evaluator and this parameter is not specified
resultType.description_zh: 评估结果类型。内联评估器场景必填；引用已有评估器时未传默认为 score
resultType.title: 结果类型：score / binary / text

type.description_en: The evaluator type. Defaults to LLM if not specified. Inline CODE evaluators are currently not supported. For CODE type evaluators, reference a previously created evaluator by using evaluatorRef
type.description_zh: 评估器类型。未传时默认 LLM；内联 CODE 评估器当前不支持，CODE 类型请通过 evaluatorRef 引用已创建评估器
type.title: 评估器类型：LLM / CODE

additionalProperties.description_en: The value of a single variable mapping, indicating the evaluation data field path from which the evaluator variable reads
additionalProperties.description_zh: 单个变量映射值，表示该评估器变量读取的评估数据字段路径

variableMapping.description_en: The variable mapping that maps evaluator variables to evaluation data fields. Required for LLM/AGENT inline evaluators. When referencing an existing evaluator, the variable names must exist in the evaluator definition
variableMapping.description_zh: 变量映射关系，将评估器变量映射到评估数据字段。LLM/AGENT 内联评估器必填，引用已有评估器时变量名必须存在于评估器定义中
variableMapping.title: 变量映射

RunStrategies.description_en: The run policy container for evaluation tasks, used to configure historical data backfill evaluation and continuous incremental evaluation
RunStrategies.description_zh: 评估任务的运行策略容器，用于配置历史数据回填评估和持续增量评估

backfill.description_en: The historical batch backfill policy. Backfill is enabled when the object exists and enabled is not explicitly set to false
backfill.description_zh: 历史批量回填策略。对象存在且 enabled 未显式为 false 时表示启用 backfill

continuous.description_en: The continuous evaluation policy. Continuous evaluation is enabled when the object exists and enabled is not explicitly set to false
continuous.description_zh: 持续评估策略。对象存在且 enabled 未显式为 false 时表示启用 continuous

kebab_example: aliyun agentloop create-evaluation-task --task-name trace_task_completion_eval --task-mode batch --data-type trace --evaluators '[{"variableMapping":{"output":"trace.output","agent_trajectory":"trace.agent_trajectory","input":"trace.input"},"evaluatorRef":"Builtin.agent_task_completion","resultType":"score","resultName":"agent_task_completion"}]' --config dataScope=trace --agent-space prod-agentspace --client-token a1b2c3d4-1234-5678-90ab-cdef12345678 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateEvaluationTask

parameters.help_en: The task name. The name must be unique among non-deleted tasks within the same user and AgentSpace. The name can be up to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 任务名称，同一用户同一 AgentSpace 下不能与未删除任务重名，长度不超过 256 字符
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en: The evaluation task mode. Set this parameter to `batch` to create a persistent evaluation task
parameters.help_zh: 评估任务模式。`batch` 创建持久评估任务
parameters.name: task_mode

parameters.help_en: The data source type of the evaluation object. Set this parameter to `trace` for trace-based evaluation
parameters.help_zh: 评估对象的数据来源类型。链路 Trace 评估使用 `trace`
parameters.name: data_type

parameters.help_en: The filter conditions for evaluation data. This parameter supports a JSON object or a JSON string. Common fields include `query`, `provided`, `maxRecords`, and `samplingRate`
parameters.help_zh: 评估数据筛选条件，支持 JSON 对象或 JSON 字符串。常用字段包括 `query`、`provided`、`maxRecords`、`samplingRate`
parameters.name: data_filter

fields.help_en: The reference name of a registered evaluator. When specified, the evaluator definition is loaded by this reference with higher priority. Both built-in evaluators and custom evaluators are supported
fields.help_zh: 已注册评估器的引用名称。传入后优先按该引用加载评估器定义，支持内置评估器和自定义评估器
fields.name: evaluator_ref

fields.help_en: The evaluator name. Required for inline evaluators when evaluatorRef is not specified. The evaluatorRef or name must be unique within the same task
fields.help_zh: 评估器名称。未传 evaluatorRef 的内联评估器场景必填；同一任务内 evaluatorRef 或 name 不能重复
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The evaluator type. Defaults to LLM if not specified. Inline CODE evaluators are currently not supported. For CODE type evaluators, reference a previously created evaluator by using evaluatorRef
fields.help_zh: 评估器类型。未传时默认 LLM；内联 CODE 评估器当前不支持，CODE 类型请通过 evaluatorRef 引用已创建评估器
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The field name for the evaluation result. Required for inline evaluators. When referencing an existing evaluator, the metricName defined in the evaluator definition is used if this parameter is not specified
fields.help_zh: 评估结果字段名。内联评估器场景必填；引用已有评估器时未传则使用评估器定义中的 metricName
fields.name: result_name

fields.help_en: The evaluation result type. Required for inline evaluators. Defaults to score when referencing an existing evaluator and this parameter is not specified
fields.help_zh: 评估结果类型。内联评估器场景必填；引用已有评估器时未传默认为 score
fields.name: result_type

fields.help_en: The evaluator runtime configuration. For inline LLM evaluators, this must include configurations such as prompt. When referencing an existing evaluator, this parameter is typically not required and is only specified when runtime parameters such as version need to be set
fields.help_zh: 评估器运行配置。内联 LLM 评估器需要包含 prompt 等配置；引用已有评估器时通常不传，仅在需要指定版本等运行时参数时传入
fields.name: config

fields.help_en: The evaluator-level data filter conditions. These take effect together with the task-level dataFilter.query
fields.help_zh: 评估器级数据筛选条件，会与任务级 dataFilter.query 共同生效
fields.name: filters

fields.help_en: The variable mapping that maps evaluator variables to evaluation data fields. Required for LLM/AGENT inline evaluators. When referencing an existing evaluator, the variable names must exist in the evaluator definition
fields.help_zh: 变量映射关系，将评估器变量映射到评估数据字段。LLM/AGENT 内联评估器必填，引用已有评估器时变量名必须存在于评估器定义中
fields.name: variable_mapping

parameters.help_en: The list of evaluator configurations. This parameter cannot be empty. Within the same task, `evaluatorRef` takes precedence as the unique identifier. Otherwise, `name` is used
parameters.help_zh: 评估器配置列表，不能为空。同一任务内以 `evaluatorRef` 优先，否则以 `name` 作为唯一标识
parameters.name: evaluators

parameters.help_en: The task source. If this parameter is not specified, the backend uses `default`
parameters.help_zh: 任务来源。未传时后端默认为 `default`
parameters.name: channel

parameters.help_en: The data source and execution configuration. When `dataType` is set to `trace`, the backend automatically populates the SLS Project and sets `storeName` to `logstore-tracing`. For trace-level evaluation, set `dataScope` to `trace`
parameters.help_zh: 数据源和执行配置。`dataType=trace` 时后端自动补齐 SLS Project 和 `storeName=logstore-tracing`；链路级 Trace 评估建议传 `dataScope=trace`
parameters.name: config

parameters.help_en: The key-value pairs of task tags. You do not need to specify this parameter by default. Specify this parameter only when you want to associate or filter tasks by business tags
parameters.help_zh: 任务标签键值对。默认无需传递；仅在需要按业务标签关联或过滤任务时传入
parameters.name: tags

fields.help_en: Specifies whether the backfill policy is enabled. If this parameter is not specified or is set to true, the policy is enabled. If this parameter is set to false, the policy is disabled but the configuration is retained
fields.help_zh: 是否启用回填策略。不传或 true 表示启用；false 表示关闭但保留配置
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The start of the backfill time range, in UNIX millisecond timestamp. Provide a complete time range when you need to manually start a backfill
fields.help_zh: 回填时间范围起点，Unix 毫秒时间戳。需要手动启动回填时应提供完整时间范围
fields.name: start_time

fields.help_en: The end of the backfill time range, in UNIX millisecond timestamp. Provide a complete time range when you need to manually start a backfill
fields.help_zh: 回填时间范围终点，Unix 毫秒时间戳。需要手动启动回填时应提供完整时间范围
fields.name: end_time

fields.help_en: The backfill evaluation policy for historical data, which specifies the time range and trigger method for a backfill run
fields.help_zh: 历史数据回填评估策略，用于指定一次回填运行的时间范围和触发方式
fields.name: backfill

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable continuous evaluation. If this parameter is not specified or is set to true, continuous evaluation is enabled. If this parameter is set to false, continuous evaluation is disabled but the configuration is retained
fields.help_zh: 是否启用持续评估。不传或 true 表示启用；false 表示关闭但保留配置
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The unit of the continuous evaluation window interval. This field is required for the current polling implementation
fields.help_zh: 持续评估窗口间隔单位。当前轮询实现需要该字段
fields.name: interval_unit

fields.help_en: The size of the continuous evaluation window interval. This parameter is used together with intervalUnit. The value must be greater than 0
fields.help_zh: 持续评估窗口间隔大小，需要与 intervalUnit 配合使用，取值应大于 0
fields.name: interval_value

fields.help_en: The data arrival delay in minutes. After a window ends, the system waits for this duration before creating a run to allow data to arrive completely. Default value: 0
fields.help_zh: 数据到达延迟时间，单位为分钟。窗口结束后延迟该时间再创建运行，用于等待数据完整到达；不传默认为 0
fields.name: data_delay_minutes

fields.help_en: The continuous evaluation policy, which is used to continuously evaluate new data within fixed time windows
fields.help_zh: 持续评估策略，用于按固定时间窗口持续评估新增数据
fields.name: continuous

parameters.help_en: The task execution strategy. This parameter supports a JSON object or a JSON string. Set this parameter to `backfill` for historical data backfill or `continuous` for continuous evaluation of new data
parameters.help_zh: 任务执行策略，支持 JSON 对象或 JSON 字符串。`backfill` 用于历史数据回填，`continuous` 用于持续评估新增数据
parameters.name: run_strategies

parameters.example: 评估线上 Agent 链路任务完成度
parameters.help_en: The description of the evaluation task
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token. This query parameter is declared in CloudSpec, but the backend does not currently perform idempotency comparison
parameters.help_zh: 幂等 Token。CloudSpec 声明了该查询参数，当前后端未做幂等比对
parameters.name: client_token

status.description_en: The evaluation task status. After creation, the status is typically `Pending`. After asynchronous orchestration, the status may change to `Running` or `Scheduling`
status.description_zh: 评估任务状态。创建后通常为 `Pending`，异步编排后可能进入 `Running` 或 `Scheduling`

v1_parameters.help_en: The idempotency token. This query parameter is declared in CloudSpec, but the backend does not currently perform idempotency comparison
v1_parameters.help_zh: 幂等 Token。CloudSpec 声明了该查询参数，当前后端未做幂等比对
v1_parameters.name: clientToken
